split.rule: families sorted, shuffled with random.Random(20261105), holdout = first ceil(n*1/3) (>=1, train keeps >=1); rows follow their family, never split

operating_point.rule: highest train-score threshold with train FNR <= 0.10 (chosen on TRAIN only, applied untouched to holdout)
